title: Kagamine Rin — Smile Night Time!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, it looks like we will be getting a chance to participate in Project Wonder.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The Smiling Nighttime part of the show that the others will be doing is when we'll be making an appearance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand that we don't have much time to rehearse until it starts, but please make sure to practice safely!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (When Emu came to us looking so sad, I was wondering if there was anything we could do for her...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now, we have that chance! We have to do what we can for her!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay☆
I'd like for us to perform the tap-dance routine that we've been working on just for Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. The plushies seem so excited. I'm sure it's because they're already able to do it flawlessly.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (We told Tsukasa and the others that they could count on us. We have to do our best!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get it down perfect☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uh, yeah.
I'll start the music then!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They're doing so well☆ It looks even better than before! That means I have to match them...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Noooo, what do I do?! 
They ended up breaking my fall!!

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line:
We're tougher than we look...!
Hey, wake up...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry. Are you okay?
Are you hurt at all...?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: I'm okay! But that did scare me a little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
How about you, Rin? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: Haha. You guys became a pretty good landing pad for her!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, you're right!
Anyways, let's keep dancing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! But don't push yourselves too hard, okay? You okay to keep going too, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I have to get it right this time...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (My feet... I completely mistimed my step there... How did that happen...?!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin? Did you forget where to step in?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-Maybe... Teehee...
Sorry, just one more time!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Here... I'm supposed to go here and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I... I'm so sorry... I know I'm supposed to step in there, but my body just won't listen to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I feel terrible. After saying all those things about wanting to help everyone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, don't worry! We all feel the same way, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everybody here, KAITO and all the others! We all want to help Tsukasa and his friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to feel responsible for everything, Rin, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We came to see you practice☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure what exactly happened just now, but I do know what we all want to help them somehow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't have to carry this all by yourself, Rin. We're all working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. But am I really gonna be able to actually help...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's what you're worried about... Miku, a word...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! What's gotten into all of you...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, more! Show us that beautiful smile we're all used to seeing, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah! But how...?
My feet kept freezing up before we all started laughing together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your mind and body were finally rejoined together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that you were scared of making the same mistake and caused you to freeze up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But laughing helped you relax. It put your mind at ease and allowed you to move forward, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin's usually so bright and cheerful, but she had this really serious look on her face just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not saying that's a bad thing in and of itself. It just may be that Rin does better when she's having fun as opposed to taking something a little too seriously.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you're all better now, right☆
You looked like you were having a lot of fun during your performance just now too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Miku, KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And I'm so sorry, plushies. You too, Len. I promise not to take things too seriously or try too hard from now on...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. That sounds a little weird, but okay!
